$comment: T-222 acquisition qualification matrix. Every ref below was located from the
target environment during the spike itself, credential-free. Refs are public
posts by institutional accounts, chosen so the fixture stays reproducible.
`expect` is what a route must observe for the cell to PASS; a route that
answers the request but misses an expectation is PARTIAL, never PASS.

mvp_cases.why: The oldest public post on the platform; stable and short.
Persian text-only post; exercises RTL without media confounds.
Root of a real 10-post same-author self-thread.
Middle of the same self-thread; tests the upward walk.
Deepest known post of the same self-thread.
Quotes a different account; the quoted post is a separate source.
A genuine long/note post of 521 characters.
A 2967-character note post, ~6x the next longest case. Included because the 521-character case left the truncation ceiling unmeasured.
Persian post with video; exercises variants and duration.
An animated GIF, which X models as a variant-bearing video.

failure_cases.why: Well-formed id that resolves to nothing; a tombstone stand-in.
failure_cases.expect_failure: must report unavailability without fabricating a record

failure_cases.why: Rejected before any request leaves the machine.
failure_cases.expect_failure: must refuse offline, with a distinct outcome

not_located.why: No public poll located in 610 credential-free posts; search is Tier 2.
not_located.structural_evidence: `x fields tweet` declares `poll` with no surface at any tier.

not_located.why: No public edited post located in 610 credential-free posts.
not_located.structural_evidence: `x fields tweet` declares `edits` with no surface at any tier.

not_located.why: No public X Article located; the tool models no Article record.
Not separable from a deleted post at any credential-free tier.
not_located.structural_evidence: Tier 0 collapses all three into one message; `x routes` puts distinguishable errors at Tier 2.

text_fidelity_cases.why: Persian prose carrying ZWNJ, Persian digits, keheh and ye; no media.
Persian post whose authored text ends in a media t.co link.
Persian post with a non-media t.co link that expands to an x.com URL.
A second Persian source, to keep the finding off one account.
